message.content:
This vertical rectangular editorial illustration features a magazine cover layout titled "TEMPO" in large black letters. Below this, smaller black text reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Above the title, two columns of white text are separated by a diagonal slash: "SIAPA BERMAIN RUU PERTANAHAN" and "MATI SURI TEKSTIL DALAM NEGERI".

The main image portrays a landscape of hazy, vertical grey shapes suggesting trees in thick smoke. In the foreground, an orangutan on the left and a man on the right stand facing each other, shaking hands. Both figures are partially engulfed in orange and yellow flames that appear to emanate from their bodies. The orangutan is covered in reddish-brown fur, with fire along its back and head. The man, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt, dark trousers, and grey shoes, has flames rising from his right shoulder and back.

Large white text overlays the top left of the scene: "BERJIBAKU MENGGANTANG ASAP". Below it, a four-line paragraph in smaller white text begins with "Serbuan jerebu akibat kebakaran lahan..." The bottom left corner displays the date "23-29 SEPTEMBER 2019", price "RP 45.000", and a barcode. A red border runs along the left and bottom edges.
